exec: const data = (() => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (_) { return null; } })();

pm.test("Response is an owned ticket with customer fields redacted", () => { pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); const ticket = data.find((t) => t.id === Number(pm.environment.get('ticketId'))); pm.expect(ticket).to.exist; for (const field of ['aiSummary','aiDraftReply','sentiment','slaDeadline','assignedAgentId','assignedAgentName']) pm.expect(ticket).to.have.property(field, null); });
